description: exSat synchronizer accounts declared in Bitcoin coinbase EXSAT commitments, associated with the pools exSat lists for them. A declaration names an exSat account; it does not establish who built the block or which account exSat credited, because exSat can credit a registered payout address ahead of the marker. xsatsync.sat, the exSat Foundation's own synchronizer, is not mapped.
observation_rule: first_party_registration: exSat's mainnet synchronizer configuration lists the account for the pool, with the pool's mining addresses. Notes give the declaring-block counts as of generated_on.

evidence.source: exsat-network/configurations src/mainnet-synchronizers.json at 536097c lists antpoole.sat for Antpool with mining addresses 39C7fxSzEACPjM78Z7xdPxhf7mKxJwvfMJ and 37jKPSmbEGwgfacCr2nayn1wTaqMAbA94Z (first listed in 922ba10)

entries.note: Requested in exsat-network/configurations issue #37, opened by AntPoolDev on 2024-10-18. AntPool blocks first declare it at 871,439 (2024-11-22). Of 21,795 carrying blocks, 18,409 are AntPool's; SecPool blocks have also declared it since 895,755 (3,001 blocks) and Mining Squared blocks did from 890,245 to 944,073 (382 blocks).
